comment: Showcase of the new island art (ShowcaseMap.cs, ShowcaseView.cs; GDD « Refonte visuelle du terrain »). Coordinates in tiles from the bottom left corner. sky: polygon of the sky beyond the island edge; river and path: lines (points, width in tiles); bankWidth: tiles of bank on each side of the river; woods: where the trees grow (centre, radius, trees); scatter: how many of each decor element (per 100 tiles of grass for the grass, flowers by clusters); spawn: where the team arrives.
